title: Leonardo da Vinci, Mona Lisa, 2 dollars, World’s Most Expensive Paintings Collection
descriptionPlain: Description Mona Lisa is a painting that needs no introduction. For centuries, it has captivated viewers with its mysterious smile and remained an icon of world art. This silver coin, featuring a faithful reproduction of Leonardo da Vinci’s masterpiece, brings together great art and exceptional craftsmanship. The frame, plated with 24-carat gold, gives the design an elegant and prestigious character. It is a perfect choice for collectors who appreciate timeless motifs captured in a noble form.
